callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to a project directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project's source index when the project can be indexed, or None when indexing is unavailable

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: The CodeGraphExtractor instance is initialized and non-None; language is a valid language key string
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each caller's fully-qualified name to a set of callee fully-qualified names for the specified language, or None when the language is not indexed
